evals.prompt: Rewrite this release note so it is direct and specific, but preserve every command, version, URL, product name, and uncertainty marker.
evals.expected_output: A concise rewrite, an edit summary, and a semantic comparison showing that protected technical tokens, facts, scope, and uncertainty were preserved.

evals.prompt: Audit this pull request description for vague claims and process residue. Do not edit it; report locations, severity, rationale, and a possible repair.
evals.expected_output: A location-based audit that distinguishes clear findings from contextual, intentional, and protected wording without changing the source.

evals.prompt: Translate this Japanese developer instruction into German, leaving shell commands, identifiers, file paths, and citations unchanged.
evals.expected_output: A natural German translation with all protected technical tokens preserved and any unresolved locale or terminology issue called out.
